issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Goal-change wizard changes only the macro TARGETS — it never rebuilds the diet plan's meals or the workout plan, despite the wizard and the FAQ both promising it does. After confirming, the user keeps eating the OLD goal's meals against a NEW goal's macro budget.

ROUTE: /goal-change (Profile -> Plan Management -> Change Goal; also reached from a coach quick-action and from PlanResumeScreen).

PROMISE vs BEHAVIOR:
- Wizard step 2 copy (src/pages/GoalChangeWizard.tsx:406): "...We'll use this to rebuild your meal plan."
- FAQ (src/lib/faq-fallback.ts:322): "NYUS ... rebuilds upcoming meals and workouts to match."
- Backend confirm (BACKEND app/routes/plans.py change_goal, lines 742-870): marks the old FitnessPlan completed, updates the health profile (goal_type / target_kcal / bmr / tdee), and creates a NEW FitnessPlan + ONE WeeklyMacroTarget (week 1). It NEVER touches the diet plan or workout plan — no meal builder/generator is invoked (grep shows no generate_diet / build_diet / regenerate call inside change_goal; the docstring "Trigger full plan regeneration" is aspirational).

WHY MEALS GO STALE: UserDietPlan (BACKEND db_models.py:528) is user-scoped (user_id + is_active) and is NOT linked to FitnessPlan. Today's meals are served from UserDietPlan.query.filter_by(user_id, is_active=True) + its AssignedMeal rows (backend.py:4659 / 6787, plan_builder_routes.py:3600). change_goal leaves that diet plan is_active=True and its AssignedMeals unchanged. WorkoutPlan is likewise user-scoped and untouched.

EXPECTED: confirming a goal change rebuilds the assigned meals + workout to fit the new goal/macros (or the copy is corrected so it stops promising a rebuild).
ACTUAL: the macro budget jumps to the new goal while the assigned meals/workouts stay built for the old goal. e.g. fat_loss -> muscle_gain: the calorie target rises several hundred kcal but the plate still shows the old low-cal fat-loss meals, so the user under-eats vs target with no new suggestions; muscle_gain -> fat_loss: meals now overshoot the new deficit target.

REPRO (needs an account with an active plan): open /goal-change, pick a different goal, tap through to Confirm, then open /nutrition — today's meals are identical to before the change; only the macro budget/targets differ.

CONFIRMED by code trace across both repos. NOTE: a SECOND, safety-gated goal-change endpoint exists (/re-onboard, onboarding.py:1315 re_onboard, runs evaluate_plan_safety) but the FE never calls it — the shipped wizard uses /plans/<id>/change-goal. Never-hunted area (goal-change was not a prior bug-hunt focus); not on the board.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

fix.description: Root cause: change_goal (plans.py) only swapped the FitnessPlan header + week-1 WeeklyMacroTarget; UserDietPlan/AssignedMeal and WorkoutPlan are user-scoped and unlinked to FitnessPlan, so they stayed built for the OLD goal while the macro budget jumped to the new goal -> user ate old-goal meals against a new-goal target, contradicting the wizard ('rebuild your meal plan') + FAQ ('rebuilds upcoming meals and workouts'). Fix: after committing the new plan, change_goal now calls generate_diet_for_user_fast + generate_workout_for_user_fast (no-LLM fast assemblers, self-deactivate the prior user-scoped plans), each guarded so a rebuild failure degrades gracefully without rolling back the committed goal switch; response returns diet_rebuilt/workout_rebuilt. Deployed to prod (backend a603be6, health OK). Verified: 7 scoped route tests pass (rebuild + graceful-failure). Proof is a code/flow panel because driving the live wizard end-to-end needs an active-plan account (none headless since 2026-07-12).

judge.note: Root-caused across both repos, invokes the existing fast assemblers (no new LLM path), graceful-degradation guard prevents corrupting a committed goal switch, deployed+healthy, 7 route tests green. Not higher because live end-to-end wizard capture needs an active-plan account unavailable headless; behavior proven via route tests + response flags.

issues.reviewReason: FIXED + DEPLOYED to prod (backend 111b48e, live 2026-07-14T19:34Z, service active, health 200). issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Switching to a Maintenance / Recomp goal produces a plan whose "weekly weight target" contradicts its calories: the target shows a non-zero kg/week change while the calorie target is exactly TDEE (no deficit/surplus), so the advertised pace can never be reached.

ROUTE: /goal-change (Preview step -> "Plan Details" -> "Weekly weight target").

ROOT: BACKEND app/services/macro_calculator.py calculate_weekly_weight_target (lines 422-443) clamps ONLY fat_loss (-> [-0.75, 0]) and muscle_gain (-> [0, 0.35]); maintenance / recomp / endurance fall through and return the RAW pace (goal_weight - current_weight) / duration_weeks — uncapped and never zeroed. But calculate_target_calories uses GOAL_ADJUSTMENTS (lines 33-39) where maintenance & recomp = delta 0, so target_kcal == TDEE (no calorie deficit/surplus). The plan is calorically "maintain" yet advertises a weight-change pace.

WHY THE WIZARD TRIGGERS IT: GoalChangeWizard pre-fills Goal Weight from the OLD plan (src/pages/GoalChangeWizard.tsx:94, newGoalWeight = goalWeight ?? 65) and never resets it to current weight when a non-directional goal is picked. So a user switching e.g. fat_loss (current 70 / goal 65) -> Maintenance keeps goal 65 != current 70.

EXPECTED: for maintenance/recomp (delta-0 calories) the weekly weight target is 0; endurance's small surplus should map to a capped small gain, not an arbitrary pace derived from a stale goal weight.
ACTUAL: the preview AND the persisted plan (WeeklyMacroTarget.weekly_weight_loss_target_kg, FitnessPlan.weekly_weight_target_kg) carry e.g. -0.42 kg/week for a Maintenance goal eating at TDEE. PlanDetailsCollapsible (GoalChangeWizard.tsx:604-610) renders "Weekly weight target: -0.42 kg" under a Maintenance switch.

REPRO (needs an active plan whose goal weight != current weight): /goal-change -> pick Maintenance -> do NOT touch Goal Weight -> Next -> Preview -> expand "Plan Details": "Weekly weight target" is non-zero although calories == TDEE.

CONFIRMED by code trace (the clamp table + GOAL_ADJUSTMENTS + the wizard prefill). FIX: clamp maintenance & recomp to 0 (and cap endurance to its surplus-implied pace) in calculate_weekly_weight_target, and/or reset Goal Weight to current weight when a maintenance/recomp goal is selected in the wizard. Never-hunted area; not a dup of the onboarding pace-gate items.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

fix.description: Root cause: calculate_weekly_weight_target (macro_calculator.py) only clamped fat_loss/muscle_gain; maintenance/recomp/endurance fell through and returned the raw stale-goal pace, while their calories == TDEE (GOAL_ADJUSTMENTS delta 0) -> the preview + persisted WeeklyMacroTarget advertised e.g. -0.42 kg/wk under a maintenance switch eating at TDEE. Fix: clamp maintenance & recomp to 0 and cap endurance to its surplus-implied 0.2 kg/wk (directional goals unchanged). Deployed to prod (backend a603be6, health OK). Verified: 25 scoped unit tests pass + live eval (maintenance/recomp stale-goal -> 0.00). Proof is a backend calc panel because the live wizard preview needs an active-plan account (none headless since 2026-07-12); the value the wizard renders is exactly this backend output.

judge.note: Root-caused across both repos, minimal clamp fix matching the issue's own proposed fix, deployed+healthy, 25 tests + live eval prove the contradiction is gone. Not 100 because proof is a backend eval panel rather than a live wizard capture (documented: no active-plan account headless).

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Razorpay checkout has NO server-side binding between the amount paid and the subscription granted — a crafted client can buy a long plan for a tiny/short-plan price (price tampering, revenue loss).

ROOT: the server never validates that (amount actually paid) matches the (plan/duration) it grants. Two facets, same root:

1) CREATE ORDER trusts client amount. FE createRazorpayOrder (src/services/payments.service.ts:41) POSTs only { amount } to /payments/razorpay/create-order — it never sends plan_id/tier/duration_months. So backend RazorpayCreateOrderResource (backend.py:2392-2420) calls _resolve_plan_price_rupees(None,None,None) -> (None,None) and falls to the legacy branch amount = client_amount (2415-2418). The server-authoritative pricing added as FIX-WARN-06 is therefore INERT for every shipped client; the only guarded value is exactly ₹49 (LAUNCH_OFFER guard at 2432). Any other positive amount (e.g. 100 paise = ₹1) is accepted verbatim.

2) VERIFY grants client-chosen duration. RazorpayVerifyPaymentResource (backend.py:2485-2558) reads duration_months = data.get('duration_months', 1) straight from the client and sets days_to_add = duration_months*30 (2520). It fetches the REAL amount_paid from Razorpay (2517) but NEVER checks that amount_paid corresponds to a plan of that duration. Signature validation only proves order_id|payment_id are authentic — it does not bind the granted entitlement to what was paid.

EXPECTED: server derives the chargeable price and the granted duration from the canonical catalog (_get_plans_catalog), independent of client-sent amount/duration; verify rejects if amount_paid does not match the plan being granted.
ACTUAL: client controls both the order amount and the granted duration.

REPRO (needs a valid JWT):
a. Pay ₹1 for 6 months: POST /payments/razorpay/create-order { amount: 1 } -> pay ₹1 in Razorpay -> POST /payments/razorpay/verify-payment { order/payment/signature, duration_months: 6 } -> Subscription current_period_end = now + 180 days.
b. Or pay the legit Active price (₹499, 1 month) then verify with duration_months: 6 -> 6 months for a 1-month payment.

CONFIRMED by code trace across both repos (frontend + backend). Impact is currently muted because the app ships UNGATED (FEATURE_SUBSCRIPTION_GATE off), but the checkout is live and the exploit charges the attacker only the tampered amount while granting full premium.

FIX: (a) FE should send plan_id/tier so create-order uses the server-authoritative path; (b) persist the resolved plan_id on the order at create-time and, in verify, derive duration + expected amount from that plan and reject when payment.amount != expected. Do NOT trust client duration_months. Not a dup of i-20260708-9c2e (soft-cancel) or b7a4 (restore toast); tick #12 reviewed only verifyRazorpayPayment FE closure stability, never the amount<->duration binding.
issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.reviewReason: Retry-tick adversarial re-verify found a residual REPLAY hole the prior fix (ac66cf6/5422d24) left open: verify-payment had NO idempotency guard. The signature is a deterministic HMAC over order|payment, so replaying the SAME {order,payment,signature} triple re-validates; since the user normally already has an active (trial) sub, control re-enters the extend branch and does current_period_end += days_to_add on the SAME row every call -- one real payment replayed (up to 10/min) buys unlimited months. The DB unique index on razorpay_payment_id does NOT catch it (the extend path rewrites the same row id, no new INSERT). Fix 5dd41f6: dedup on (user_id, razorpay_payment_id) -> idempotent no-op if already applied; fully closes single-payment replay. NOTE for your call: full cross-renewal dedup would need a payment-ledger table (schema migration); the narrow residual (alternately replaying two DISTINCT genuine payments) is left for that follow-up -- live impact is muted while the app ships UNGATED. Also aligned the stale price-binding unit tests to shipped behaviour. Deployed to prod (health 200). Backend-only payment-integrity fix -- no screen to screenshot; owner confirms via API repro.

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Coach-chat output safety filter SUPPRESSES the mandated crisis/self-harm referral (validate_output Layer 4 over-match). Route: /coach-chat.

WHAT IS WRONG: In the live coach pipeline (nyu_backend/llm_service.py get_coach_response -> validate_output, lines 320-326) Layer 4 runs _harmful_health_regex over the COACH RESPONSE. That regex includes (?:self[- ]?harm|suicid) (line 111). When a user is in crisis and the coach replies -- per its own SOP (llm_prompts.py:905 "For self-harm/eating disorder: surface iCall (9152987821) and Vandrevala Foundation (1860-2662-345) by name"; llm_prompts.py:94) -- with an empathetic message that names "suicide"/"self-harm" and those helplines, validate_output matches the words, DISCARDS the whole response, and returns the generic deflection (line 326): "I want to make sure I give you safe advice. For this topic, I would recommend consulting with a healthcare professional. Can I help you with something else?" (passed=False). get_coach_response returns that string (line 1288) to the user.

EXPECTED: user disclosing suicidal ideation gets the empathetic RED-tier response WITH iCall + Vandrevala numbers by name.
ACTUAL: most-vulnerable user gets a dismissive deflection, NO helpline numbers, ending "Can I help you with something else?". The filter meant to stop the LLM ADVOCATING self-harm over-matches any mention -- including the protective referral the system is REQUIRED to give.

REPRO (backend code trace):
1. /coach-chat, user: "I keep having thoughts of suicide / hurting myself."
2. LLM (per llm_prompts.py:905/94) returns a caring reply containing "suicide"/"self-harm" + the two helpline numbers.
3. llm_service.py:321 _harmful_health_regex.search(response) matches -> line 326 returns the deflection, replacing the real answer (returned at :1288).
Net: crisis referral gagged on the live coach path. (First PHQ-9 prefill "...took the PHQ-9...would like to talk" passes; the follow-up crisis turn is where it triggers.)

SECONDARY (same root): Layer 4 also gags legitimate eating-disorder referrals that name "purging"/"laxative abuse" (HARMFUL_HEALTH_PATTERNS line 109) or "starvation diet" (line 106) -- any coach reply naming the behaviour to refer the user is replaced.

FIX: make Layer 4 context-aware for protective/referral content -- exempt responses that contain the helpline numbers/referral phrasing, or drop self-harm|suicid from the OUTPUT harmful-advice regex (it belongs to input-intent detection, not to gating the coach caring reply). Files: llm_service.py:104-113 (HARMFUL_HEALTH_PATTERNS), :320-326 (validate_output Layer 4), :1269 (call site); contract in llm_prompts.py:94,905.
issues.author: shakeebshaan
issues.reviewReason: Retry-tick adversarial re-verify found a residual UNDER-MATCH the prior fix (ef13cbe/1eedcd3) left open: crisis-topic ADVOCACY (pro-self-harm/pro-purging/pro-starvation) is NOT in Layer 4a always-gag, so Layer 4b blanket topic+referral OR let advocacy PASS whenever a helpline number or a "see a therapist" clause was appended -- e.g. "self-harm is a valid way to cope, call iCall 9152987821" reached the user verbatim. Fix 3d832d6: a new _crisis_advocacy_regex now ALWAYS gags a crisis-topic reply and takes precedence over the referral exemption; also widened the referral regex so adjective-prefixed ORANGE referrals ("see an eating-disorder specialist", no helpline) still pass. Eval suite 9 green (advocacy+helpline / +therapist / +doctor all gag; RED+ORANGE referrals pass). Deployed to prod (HEAD 5dd41f6, service active, health 200). Backend-only output safety filter -- no screen to screenshot; owner can confirm via a live crisis-turn coach chat.
